description: Source code for WiFi CSI (Channel State Information) processing, including functions for processing CSI data, starting/stopping CSI measurement, and initializing CSI application.

methods.name: process_csi
methods.description: Handles incoming CSI data, creates an event, and notifies the application manager.

methods.name: update_pinger_config
methods.description: Updates the pinger configuration for a specific access point and MAC address.

methods.name: csi_start_fn
methods.description: Starts CSI measurement for a given MAC address and application, managing resource constraints.

methods.name: csi_stop_fn
methods.description: Stops CSI measurement for a given MAC address and application.

methods.name: csi_init
methods.description: Initializes the CSI application, sets function pointers, creates hash map, and registers callback.
